security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation for LibreOffice Writer workflows, and most static hits are Markdown code fences, resource links, or safe temporary directory usage. Two subprocess examples are confirmed because copied automation would run zip and unzip on caller-provided paths without validation or error checks. No prompt injection attempt or malicious exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Archive commands run on caller-provided paths in the template example.
remediation.suggestion: Use Python archive libraries with path traversal checks, reject option-like paths, validate file extensions, and check command failures.

remediation.issue: Template variables are inserted into content.xml without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Escape XML values before replacement or use an ODF library that writes text nodes safely.

remediation.issue: Command examples do not state trust boundaries for local files and services.
remediation.suggestion: Document that commands should run only on trusted files and keep UNO socket listeners bound to localhost.

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable documents in open formats. This skill guides LibreOffice Writer creation, conversion, mail merge, and automation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create new ODT documents from scratch or from templates.
Convert documents between ODT, DOCX, PDF, HTML, RTF, TXT, and EPUB formats.
Plan mail merge workflows using CSV, spreadsheets, or database sources.
Automate batch document processing with LibreOffice command line examples.
Explain Writer style, metadata, accessibility, header, footer, and table workflows.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice or compatible Python libraries on the local system.
Does not include a packaged executable or tested automation script.
Complex format conversions can lose layout fidelity and require manual review.
Automation examples need validation before use with untrusted documents or data.

use_cases.title: Build Document Templates
use_cases.description: Create reusable ODT templates with styles, metadata, fields, and export rules for recurring business documents.

use_cases.title: Convert Office Files
use_cases.description: Plan document conversions between Writer, Word, PDF, and web formats using LibreOffice workflows.

use_cases.title: Automate Mail Merge
use_cases.description: Design template-based document generation from CSV, spreadsheet, or database sources with output checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple ODT document outline with headings, body sections, and metadata for [topic].

prompt_templates.title: Plan File Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this document workflow from DOCX to PDF and explain the LibreOffice Writer steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Mail Merge
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a mail merge process using a CSV source, Writer template fields, validation checks, and PDF output.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Batch Processing
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an automated batch conversion plan for mixed ODT, DOCX, and RTF files with error handling and logging.

output_examples.input: Create a policy document template for onboarding.
output_examples.output: A structured Writer template plan with title page, heading styles, required sections, metadata, and export guidance.

output_examples.input: Convert a folder of ODT files to PDF.
output_examples.output: A batch conversion workflow with required tools, naming rules, failure handling, and post-conversion review steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare customer letters from a CSV file.
output_examples.output: A mail merge plan covering source fields, template placeholders, validation, generation, and final PDF checks.

best_practices: Use Writer styles and metadata to keep generated documents consistent.
Validate input files and data before running conversion or merge workflows.
Review converted files for layout, accessibility, fonts, and embedded content.
anti_patterns: Do not run automation examples on untrusted files without validation.
Do not replace XML template values without escaping user-provided content.
Do not assume every conversion preserves layout, fields, or metadata exactly.

faq.question: What does this skill help automate?
faq.answer: It helps plan Writer document creation, conversion, templates, mail merge, and batch processing workflows.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. Command line conversion and UNO automation require LibreOffice installed on the local system.

faq.question: Can it create PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes LibreOffice Writer workflows for exporting ODT and other documents to PDF.

faq.question: Can it work with DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers DOCX to ODT conversion and ODT to DOCX export workflows.

faq.question: Is it a finished automation library?
faq.answer: No. It is a guidance skill with examples, not a packaged library or tested application.

faq.question: What should users review before automation?
faq.answer: Users should validate file paths, escape template values, check command failures, and inspect converted output.
